definition: The flight instance exists in the schedule but has not yet begun its operational day.
The flight instance has departed and has not yet arrived.
The flight instance has arrived at its destination (or diversion) airport.
Estimated/actual times are materially later than scheduled; see the associated DelayEvent.
The flight instance was withdrawn and did not operate.
The flight instance landed at an airport other than its scheduled destination.
No source has reported a status within the freshness window.
